text:
Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, roughly 12% of API requests returned HTTP 502 errors. A deploy released at 14:02 removed a cache warmup step from the startup sequence, so application instances began serving traffic before their caches were populated. Under load, a portion of requests timed out upstream and returned 502.

Our team identified the change and rolled back the deploy at 14:27. Error rates returned to normal by 14:31, and the service has been stable since.

We are adding a startup readiness check that blocks traffic until cache warmup finishes, along with a deploy-time test covering this path. We apologize for the disruption.
